vibe: ambient cinematic piano, contemplative, low drone, sparse
vibe_long: Slow contemplative underscore for the contemplative register (oracle / spiritual-tech / luxury-quiet / liturgical-product brands). Sustained piano, low drone bed, sparse harp or arco strings. NO drum kit, NO synth lead, NO acoustic guitar (that's warm-community). NO percussive transient. Slow tempo (50-70 BPM, often unmetered). Tracks should feel like candlelight breathing — never hurried, never busy. Pairs with a TTS voiceover at vol 0.95 above the music at vol 0.18 (memory rule from singularity-convergence v2 build 2026-04-27).
